about: The index of the reach records of run 45196235508 (council/records/2026-11-17-g3-whole-flow-cases.md, sixth addendum, decision P3, item 5, gate WF33; council/records/2026-11-22-eda-tools-seat-account.md, second addendum, decision R2), dispatched on main at bbcf06a9 with purpose calibration. It was the measured run of the plan's section 10 until the change of that addendum moved both whole-flow fingerprints; it is no longer the measured run. Its reach records are committed here as records only, in the layout of decision R2. It is not the gate ET10 index and is never read as the gate ET10 file. In its live-eval and rejudge jobs, the listed probes were denied to nirmaan-seat through the named tools. The files in evals/flow/tool_reach_measured_run_superseded_45196235508/ are, for each job, the tool reach record and the seat C reach record the job uploaded, each named here with the sha256 of its bytes. The first_part lines of each job are the lines the reach step's first part printed, copied from the job's log with their timestamps cut: a copy from the log, not an uploaded file. values_18_1 are the values of the plan's section 18.1 computed on that commit. It covers no other run, no other commit and no slot, and it states nothing of the run's trial.
